requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest, from your criminal history report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Arresting law enforcement agency, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Arresting law enforcement agency, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency that arrested you, from your criminal history report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Offences arrested for, as the record states them, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Offences arrested for, as the record states them, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offences you were arrested for, worded as the record words them

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County of arrest, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County of arrest, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Georgia county where you were arrested, from your criminal history report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court that handled the case, and its case number, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court that handled the case, and its case number, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that handled the case and the case number, from your court paperwork - the clerk of that court holds the file

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the case ended (the disposition), exactly as the court record states it, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the case ended (the disposition), exactly as the court record states it, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the disposition, exactly as the court record states it - checked against your criminal history report and, where it is missing or wrong there, against the certified final disposition from the clerk

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the case ended, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the case ended, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the case ended, from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The requester's own statement of what they are asking the office to do and why the record matters now, in paragraph 3 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The requester's own statement of what they are asking the office to do and why the record matters now, in paragraph 3 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the participant's own account and writes none of it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own words: what you are asking the prosecuting attorney's office to do, and why this record matters to you now - these lines are yours alone

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Office name and postal or e-mail destination of the prosecuting attorney, in the addressee block of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Office name and postal or e-mail destination of the prosecuting attorney, in the addressee block of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: intake format and destination vary by county office and must be confirmed with that office; no directory is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the prosecuting attorney's office for the county of arrest, and the postal or e-mail destination that office directs - intake format and destination vary by county, so confirm both with the office before sending, and ask whether it has its own intake form

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Which court issued the certified disposition being attached, and the date it bears
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Which court issued the certified disposition being attached, and the date it bears
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the certified disposition is a record the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the issuing court and the date on the certified final disposition, copied from the document itself after you obtain it from the clerk of the court that handled the case

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the written request
protectedBlanks.why: the request is the participant's own; the participant signs it personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the written request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
